name: multi-location-stress-v1
note: Counterfactual extra pins on the fixed benchmark posts. These are deliberately chosen stress cases, not independent real-world validation.

scenarios.hypothesis: A text-only first location can gain a useful coordinate from a later possible place.
Both sides can provide a coordinate after their text-only first location.
Extra plausible places may also boost competing wallet posts.
A wrong key post may receive a close secondary pin while the true found post lacks coordinates.
